scope: Переверстка главной DPECO под Figma Page 10, сохранение существующих эффектов и вторичных маршрутов, адаптивная светлая и темная темы. Публикация на существующем GitHub Pages preview.

application.change_after_previous_checkpoint: Только композиция и размеры декоративных масок блока консультации.

design_source.authority: USER_DECISION: актуальный визуальный эталон из поручения от 11.11.2026.

build_and_delivery.method: TypeScript check, production build, GitHub Actions readback and published HTML readback.

published_html.evidence_type: Readback of the published HTML, reported in the deployment review.

implementation_review.method: Review of source, design contexts, rendered content and route integration; this is not a live interaction certification.
changes: Updated Page 10 content and responsive layout
Original Figma artwork and complete brand exports
Dated auction snapshot with Moscow timestamps
implementation_review.qualification: Code integration and static renders do not prove all animations, keyboard paths or interaction transitions in a live browser.

visual_review.method: Full-page inspection of real published-page captures, comparison with Figma, correction of observed defects and targeted repeat captures.

focus: Partner logo mapping, size and tone

resolved_findings.finding: Narrow schedule period text extended beyond its background
Long debit-receivables CTA compressed its arrow
resolved_findings.result: Text wraps to two lines and the arrow remains visible.

resolved_findings.finding: SKM card used the Trust image
SKM and Trust SVGs stretched by flex alignment
resolved_findings.result: SKM approximately 99 x 21 px; Trust SVG 51 x 50 px; partner cards approximately 152 px high.

resolved_findings.finding: Observed wrapping, contrast, logo, background and arrow defects
resolved_findings.result: Corrected and rechecked in the recorded coverage.

final_consultation_mask.finding: The hard right edge disappeared. The soft arc, edges and contrast match the Figma reference; no overlap with form content was observed.
final_consultation_mask.review_extent: Final consultation mask composition and adjacent content.

visual_review.version_qualification: The broad visual matrix was completed before the last mask-only patch. The final application commit received the targeted consultation-mask repeat above. No claim is made that every viewport was recaptured after the last patch.
visual_review.interaction_qualification: Static screenshots cannot certify swipes, menus, theme-button state transitions, form errors, email-draft opening or animation timing.

assets.source_policy: Original Figma assets and exact whole-logo exports; no generated or redrawn brand replacements.

webp_conversion.method: Lossless WebP; decoded RGBA equality checked against original PNG/JPEG files.
webp_conversion.qualification: Only beneficial referenced replacements were retained in the runtime asset set; unused originals and exports were archived outside the repository.

manrope.verification: WOFF2 decompression preserved cmap, glyph order, outlines, horizontal metrics, variation data and axes.

auction_data.qualification: Displayed rows are a dated content snapshot, not a claim of live auction status.

consultation.behavior: Client validation and preparation of an email draft in the existing mail flow.
consultation.qualification: The interface does not claim that a request was sent. Actual live form and mail-client interaction remains part of the blocked interactive run.

content_and_integration_limits.source_fidelity_vs_business_verification: Visual/content fidelity to the supplied design does not independently verify business claims, memberships, legal wording or production integrations.

blocked_checks.reason: After reload, the available CUA browser returned 'upstream connect timeout', preventing completion of the full live interactive run.
required_scenarios: Header menus, dropdowns, search and keyboard focus
Theme toggle, persistence and system-theme behavior
Form validation, consent states and email-draft opening
blocked_checks.next_step: Restore a working authorized live-browser session and run the listed scenarios on the current published commit.

blocked_checks.reason: No completed live Safari session was available for final acceptance.
blocked_checks.qualification: Chromium-based captures and static review do not substitute for Safari behavior verification.
blocked_checks.next_step: Run the same relevant layout and interaction scenarios in actual Safari, including masks, fixed UI, theme state and form behavior.

acceptance_policy: All requirements remain in scope. Passed build, HTTP 200 and screenshot checks do not close blocked live-interaction or Safari criteria.
next_step: Complete the live interactive browser run and Safari acceptance on the published candidate. Repair and recheck any new defect, then update this report and the hashed acceptance receipt.
report_privacy: Contains public source and CI URLs, repository-relative paths and evidence fingerprints only; excludes internal server paths and signed capture URLs.
